messages.output_raw:
Can’t reliably check “on time” status that far in advance—real flight status only exists day‑of (usually within 24–48 hours of departure).

What you can do:

- 1–2 weeks before June 15, 2027:  
  - Go to United.com or the United app  
  - Use “Flight status” and enter: UA9020 + date (2027‑06‑15)

- Day before / day of departure:  
  - Recheck in the United app (most accurate: gate, delays, equipment changes)  
  - Optionally cross‑check on FlightAware/FlightRadar24 with the same flight number and date  

If you want, tell me your departure and arrival airports and I can outline how to monitor that specific route’s delay history to gauge how “reliable” UA9020 tends to be.
